Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: SK Digital
Message:
feat: static analysis overhaul — Laravel 12 / PHP 8.3 standards compliance

- Convert all 63 models from $casts property to casts() method (Laravel 11+)
- Add Builder type hints and return types to 64 scope methods across 25 models
- Add explicit return types to all model relationship and utility methods
- Add full type declarations to service layer (IoT, MineArea, Production, RealTimeAlert)
- Add recordReading() method to IoTSensorService
- Add JsonResponse/StreamedResponse/BinaryFileResponse/RedirectResponse return types to all controllers
- Add Illuminate\View\View return types and :void to all 28 Livewire component methods
- Replace auth()->user()/auth()->id() with Auth::user()/Auth::id() throughout
- Add missing Auth, Response, and Eloquent relation imports across controllers/models/Livewire
- Fix duplicate HasMany import in Integration model
- Replace hardcoded href/url() with route() calls in Blade templates; name root route 'home'
- Fix MinePlanDownloadController: replace undefined MinePlan with MinePlanUpload, typed Storage adapters
- Update README: add June 2026 static analysis section, update PHP badge to 8.3
